description: Reserved Matters Application relating to the layout, scale, appearance, access and landscaping for Plot 23 comprising:  Large-Scale Purpose-Built Shared Living accommodation (Sui Generis) with internal communal amenities, external roof gardens, associated cycle and refuse storage space, within a building of 10, 14 and 15 storeys in height, and public realm to the south of the building. The application is submitted pursuant to Conditions 1.3(v) and 2.1 in relation to the Phase 5E sub-phase of planning permission F/04687/13 (dated 23rd July 2014) for the comprehensive mixed use redevelopment of the Brent Cross Cricklewood Area. The application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement of Compliance.
site_name: Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area, North West London
